catalysts.headline: FutureFuel reported Q3 2026 results: revenue of $104.7M (+361% YoY) driven by the biofuels segment, but a GAAP net loss of $8.4M (-$0.19/share) due to high soybean oil costs and $8.7M of hedging losses; management guided to positive adjusted EBITDA in Q4 2026 and full-year 2026
catalysts.impact: Large revenue beat/jump alongside a continued net loss and a ~$5M adjusted EBITDA loss for the quarter

catalysts.headline: FutureFuel Q3 2026 results: revenue $104.7M (up from $22.7M in Q3 2025); net loss $8.4M (-$0.19/diluted share) vs $9.2M loss a year earlier; Biofuel segment posted a $9.8M gross loss on elevated feedstock costs and $8.7M in derivative losses despite record production/sales volumes and higher utilization; Chemicals segment revenue grew from capacity expansions despite maintenance-driven volume declines; management said orders booked through early November covered >90% of Q4 biodiesel production capacity and guided to ~$7M of Q4 adjusted EBITDA; plan outlined to rebuild cash to $50M over the next year
catalysts.impact: Stock fell sharply after the print; magnitude reported inconsistently across sources from -29% to -45% (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: FutureFuel declared Q3 2026 cash dividend of $0.01/share (payable Sept. 18, 2026 to holders of record Sept. 4, 2026), maintaining the reduced rate
